people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Mephibosheth
people.line: Son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.

translations.web: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem; for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.
translations.bsb: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table, and he was lame in both feet.
translations.kjv: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.
translations.asv: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem; for he did eat continually at the king's table. And he was lame in both his feet.
